scope: Opening Latveria level traversal, pauses and obstacle contact; not combat

measurement.method: delta unique XFB frame_count / monotonic wall seconds; duplicate presents excluded

visual_checks: Native screenshots inspected: opening cinematic, populated level/environment/HUD/minimap, player displacement and party-following. Not every rendered frame inspected. Full visual correctness unverified.
limitations: Headless fps/vps status fields were zero; used unique frame_count deltas instead.
Traversal includes idle gaps and obstacle contact, not continuous combat.
Normal window presentation, audio, GPU utilization and bottleneck not measured.
